summary: Job logs show what each run actually did, and jobs that recovered stop showing as failing.

new.title: Logs show the full run output
new.text: The Logs button on Jobs shows everything a run checked and changed, with warnings and errors. Live tail shows progress while an engine job runs.

fixes.title: Run now works for every scheduled check
fixes.text: Run now on the convergence check and discovery jobs queues them for the scheduler instead of reporting not implemented.

fixes.title: Recovered jobs no longer show as failing
fixes.text: Earlier failures of a job that has since recovered show under History. Ack clears all standing failures of a job in one click.
